section_summary.extract_value: This Methods section describes Study 1, which involved 382 U.S. community participants (192 women, 190 men) recruited via Amazon Mechanical Turk who completed an online survey via SurveyMonkey. Participants completed the 10-item BAS-2 (with modified Item 8) and self-reported their height and weight for BMI calculation. The sample was 71.9% White, had a mean age of 33.38 years, and 86.1% had at least one year of college education.
